question: Who among the following founded the Asiatic Society of Bengal in 1784?
solution:
The correct answer is __**William Jones**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asiatic Society of Bengal **__

 
 
• **Sir William Jones** was an Anglo-Welsh philologist, a judge on the Supreme Court of Judicature at Fort William in Bengal, and a scholar of ancient India.
 
• **The Asiatic Society was founded in 1784 by Sir. William Jones. **Hence, Option 3 is correct.
